transitions.from: connection interruption error with retry offered
transitions.outcome: the alert region clears and the confirmation dialog again reports the confirmed elimination as in progress while the selected cultural heritage stays unchanged and listed

validations: The retry action is offered only for the interrupted confirmed elimination and only while the confirmation dialog for that cultural heritage is still open.
No success notification is displayed for an interrupted elimination.

nodes.contract: Deletes the single CulturalHeritage record identified by culturalHeritageId from persistent storage and reports whether one record was removed.
nodes.evidence_reason: GAP: the inspected database schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma declares exactly one model, SystemMetadata (key, value, createdAt, updatedAt), and the inspected composition owner packages/db/src/client.ts exposes only createDatabaseClient, getDatabaseClient and closeDatabase; no CulturalHeritage record type and no delete operation on it exist anywhere in the database package, so MF-4/BR-1/AC-1 cannot remove the selected cultural choice. A new profile-owned persistence adapter callable is added in packages/db/src and injected with the shared Prisma client from getDatabaseClient, because the existing anchors (systemMetadata.count / systemMetadata.findUnique on SystemMetadata) only read a system metadata row and cannot host the deletion of a CulturalHeritage.
nodes.name: CulturalHeritage record deletion persistence

constraints: culturalHeritageId identifies exactly one CulturalHeritage record and is required for the delete
no CulturalHeritage record is removed when the identifier matches no stored record
surface_contract.migration_intent: add: introduce a new CulturalHeritage model together with its delete persistence path in the database package; no existing SystemMetadata table or migration is altered
surface_contract.operation: write: delete the CulturalHeritage record selected by culturalHeritageId and report whether one record was removed
